decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - C13	The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as Class B2 industrial use and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 4 - The mezzanine floor indicated on drawing number 1588/ARCH/03/F shall be used as storage space ancillary to the main use of the premises as B2 and shall not be used for any other purpose

Condition : 5 - No industrial or storage activity shall be carried on outside the buildings hereby permitted except for loading and unloading without the prior written consent of the Local Planning authority..
Condition : 6 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - No equipment or machinery producing continuous noise levels of more than 90dBA measure one metre from the equipment/machinery shall be installed within the units.
description: Variation of condition 4 to planning reference 00229/Q/P9 for the mezzanine floor to be used as ancillary floor space for a B2 industrial unit for in-flight catering facility.
